text.tspan: The Eyes of the Lord Run
Running to and fro to strengthen them,
Running to and fro to strengthen them
Whose heart is perfect toward Him.
He’s watching over those who fear Him and hope,
fear Him and hope, fear Him and hope;
He’s watching over those who fear Him and hope
He’s looking on the righteous—hearing their prayer,
Hearing their prayer, hearing their prayer;
He’s looking on the righteous—hearing their prayer
His eyes and His heart are always there,
His eyes and His heart are always there,
In the place that He has chosen.
The eyes of the Lord run to and fro,
The eyes of the Lord run to and fro
